card.text: L 98-59 b was found in 2019 by TESS as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "L 98-59 b"
sources.quote: L 98-59 b is an exoplanet having a size between that of the Earth and Mars and a mass only half that of Venus.

introduction.text: It is one of 5 planets known around L 98-59. Its orbit and size follow Cadieux et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.

sources.quote: It orbits L 98-59, a red dwarf star 34.6 light-years away in the constellation Volans.
